Red buffalo
Oct 2026 • Couples
We walked by and looked at this bar, they often sing karaoke, seems fun.
Decided to go in.
We placed an order at 11 PM, there were few people, then it was just the two of us.
At first it seemed cool, the waiters were taking pictures, asking to take photos, leave reviews on Insta, etc. 
Waited 30 minutes for food!!!! They asked why it was taking so long, they didn't really answer anything, they said another 25 minutes... It turned out that while they were taking pictures with us, they forgot to place the order for the kitchen, even though no one else was on the second floor!!!
It was already too late, they decided to wait.
In the end, a regular burger with fries took 1 hour!!!! On an empty landing!!!
The evening was ruined, came in a great mood and left in a bad one.
Summary: No more! 
The beer is so-so, a 4 out of 10, and it's only Filipino.
